ema_fast.description: Fast EMA period for trend direction and momentum detection
ema_fast.impact: lower = more responsive but more noise in signal

ema_slow.description: Slow EMA period for trend baseline
ema_slow.impact: higher = smoother trend signal but more lag at inflections

rsi_low.description: RSI minimum threshold for long entry filter
rsi_low.impact: higher = fewer long entries, only higher-momentum setups qualify

rsi_high.description: RSI maximum threshold for short entry filter
rsi_high.impact: lower = fewer short entries, only higher-momentum setups qualify

rsi_long_max.description: RSI ceiling for long entries — prevents chasing overbought conditions
rsi_long_max.impact: lower = more conservative, blocks entries at extended overbought RSI levels

rsi_short_min.description: RSI floor for short entries — prevents fading deeply oversold conditions
rsi_short_min.impact: higher = more conservative, blocks short entries at extreme oversold RSI levels

volume_ratio_min.description: Volume must exceed 20-period MA by this multiple for confirmation
volume_ratio_min.impact: higher = fewer signals, higher volume conviction required per entry

tp_atr_multiplier.description: Take-profit distance expressed as ATR14 multiples from entry
tp_atr_multiplier.impact: higher = larger TP targets, lower win rate but higher avg win per trade

sl_atr_multiplier.description: Stop-loss distance expressed as ATR14 multiples from entry (raised 1.0->1.5 on 2026-06-16: a 1-ATR stop sits inside the short-TF noise band and caused a 54% premature full-stop-out rate)
sl_atr_multiplier.impact: lower = tighter SL, more frequent SL hits but smaller individual losses; ~1.5 keeps the stop outside normal noise

min_confidence.description: Minimum signal confidence score required to fire an order
min_confidence.impact: higher = fewer but higher-quality signals, lower throughput

adx_trend_min.description: ADX threshold above which market is classified as TRENDING regime
adx_trend_min.impact: higher = stricter trending definition, more signals fall into RANGING

adx_strong_min.description: ADX floor for the mom_adx/triple_mom confluence-momentum entry: a price streak only fires as a momentum signal when ADX exceeds this (a genuinely strong trend)
adx_strong_min.impact: higher = fewer, stronger-trend-only momentum entries; lower = more entries in weaker trends (validated value 25.0)

bb_width_threshold.description: Bollinger Band width threshold below which market is classified as RANGING
bb_width_threshold.impact: lower = stricter RANGING definition, fewer RANGING-eligible signals

max_hold_candles.description: Maximum candles to hold a position before forced timeout exit (widened to 48 so trailing-close runners can ride extended moves)
max_hold_candles.impact: higher = more time for TP/trail to develop, but more exposure to adverse moves

max_active_buckets.description: Maximum number of concurrent open positions across all pairs
max_active_buckets.impact: higher = more simultaneous trades, more total capital at risk

body_ratio_min.description: Minimum body-to-range ratio for impulse candle qualification
body_ratio_min.impact: higher = only strong conviction impulse candles qualify, fewer signals

wick_ratio_min.description: Minimum wick-to-body ratio for wick rejection pattern qualification
wick_ratio_min.impact: higher = only long wick rejections qualify, fewer but stronger reversals

compression_factor.description: ATR(5)/ATR(20) ratio threshold below which compression squeeze is detected
compression_factor.impact: lower = stricter compression requirement, fewer but cleaner breakouts

ema_spread_threshold.description: Minimum EMA fast/slow spread as fraction of price to confirm trending regime
ema_spread_threshold.impact: higher = stricter trending definition, prevents weak trend misclassification

atr_volatile_multiplier.description: ATR14/ATR50 ratio above which regime is classified as VOLATILE
atr_volatile_multiplier.impact: lower = more VOLATILE periods, higher = only extreme volatility qualifies

atr_quiet_multiplier.description: ATR14/ATR50 ratio below which regime is QUIET (all signals blocked)
atr_quiet_multiplier.impact: higher = more periods blocked as QUIET, fewer total signals fired

retracement_min.description: Minimum retracement fraction of trigger body for impulse_retracement pattern
retracement_min.impact: lower = shallower retracements accepted, more signals but weaker setups

retracement_max.description: Maximum retracement fraction of trigger body for impulse_retracement pattern
retracement_max.impact: higher = deeper retracements accepted, higher risk of trend invalidation

anomaly_volume_stddev.description: Volume standard deviations above mean required for anomaly_fade qualification
anomaly_volume_stddev.impact: higher = only extreme volume spikes qualify, fewer but more reliable fades

anomaly_price_atr.description: ATR multiples of single-candle move required for anomaly_fade qualification
anomaly_price_atr.impact: higher = only extreme price moves qualify, fewer anomaly fade entries

momentum_acceleration_candles.description: Consecutive same-direction accelerating candles required for momentum_continuation setup
momentum_acceleration_candles.impact: higher = stronger momentum confirmation required before entry

size_fraction_full.description: Fraction of current bucket equity deployed on a full-conviction (confidence>=0.75) trade — equity-scaled position sizing
size_fraction_full.impact: higher = larger positions and faster compounding, but bigger swings

size_fraction_half.description: Fraction of current bucket equity deployed on a medium-conviction (0.55-0.74) trade
size_fraction_half.impact: higher = medium-conviction trades risk more of the bucket

size_min_usdt.description: Minimum viable position size in USDT — below this the bucket is treated as exhausted and trading stops
size_min_usdt.impact: higher = stops trading a bled-down bucket sooner (avoids fee-dominated dust trades)

drawdown_derisk_threshold.description: Equity drawdown below the bucket peak at which position size is reduced (drawdown de-risking)
drawdown_derisk_threshold.impact: lower = de-risk earlier into a losing streak, preserving capital

drawdown_derisk_factor.description: Multiplier applied to position size while in drawdown beyond the threshold
drawdown_derisk_factor.impact: lower = cut size harder during drawdowns (1.0 disables de-risking)

consec_loss_cooloff.description: Number of consecutive losing trades after which position size is reduced (loss cool-off)
consec_loss_cooloff.impact: lower = react to losing streaks sooner

consec_loss_factor.description: Multiplier applied to position size after the consecutive-loss threshold is hit
consec_loss_factor.impact: lower = cut size harder after a losing streak (1.0 disables cool-off)

trailing_enabled.description: Enable trailing-close: once a position is in profit the stop ratchets toward price, replacing the fixed take-profit so winners ride. Set per-bot in bots.json for A/B lab variants
trailing_enabled.impact: true = let winners run and exit on reversal instead of a fixed TP; raises avg win, may lower raw win rate

trail_activation_r.description: Favourable excursion, in units of the initial stop distance R (= sl_atr_multiplier x ATR), at which the trailing stop arms (lowered 1.0->0.5 on 2026-06-16 to arm earlier and scratch good-then-bad trades near breakeven instead of riding back to a full stop)
trail_activation_r.impact: lower = trailing arms sooner and locks profit earlier; higher = waits for a stronger move before protecting

trail_distance_r.description: Gap the trailing stop holds below the running peak, in units of the initial stop distance R (lowered 0.8->0.5 on 2026-06-16: paired with the 0.5R activation, a trade that runs +0.5R then reverses exits at ~breakeven)
trail_distance_r.impact: lower = tighter trail, banks profit fast but gets shaken out; higher = gives the move room to breathe

max_loss_pct_per_trade.description: Risk hardening: maximum fraction of bucket equity a single stop-out may lose. Position size is shrunk (signal/sizing.py cap_size_for_risk) so notional x SL-distance <= this x equity, bounding per-trade downside independently of leverage. Lowered 0.05->0.01 on 2026-06-16 to cut exposure: with the 1.5-ATR stop this sets per-trade notional ~1.1x equity (was ~3.3x at 0.02/1-ATR), within the ~2x-equity portfolio guidance.
max_loss_pct_per_trade.impact: lower = smaller positions and tighter per-trade loss control (but at high leverage may fall below the broker min-lot in live); higher = larger positions, bigger loss per stop. The strongest companion lever is lower LEVERAGE in .env.

tp_sl_pct_enabled.description: Use fixed-percent reward:risk TP/SL (tp_pct/sl_pct of entry price) instead of ATR-multiple distances. Set per-bot in bots.json for A/B lab variants. The pct stop is auto-clamped inside the liquidation distance (~1/leverage) by signal/detector.py.
tp_sl_pct_enabled.impact: true = deterministic R:R independent of volatility (e.g. 5% TP / 2.5% SL = 2:1); false = ATR-scaled distances that breathe with volatility

tp_pct.description: Take-profit distance as a fraction of entry price when tp_sl_pct_enabled (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). With trailing on, this is the fallback target the trail replaces.
tp_pct.impact: higher = larger targets, lower win rate but higher reward:risk per win

sl_pct.description: Stop-loss distance as a fraction of entry price when tp_sl_pct_enabled (e.g. 0.025 = 2.5%). Reward:risk = tp_pct/sl_pct. Detector clamps this inside 0.7/leverage so liquidation never front-runs the stop.
sl_pct.impact: lower = tighter stops (more SL hits, smaller per-loss); must stay well below 1/leverage or the clamp tightens it further

seasonal_entry_hour_start.description: UTC hour at which the session_seasonal long window opens. backtest_seasonality.py found the US-afternoon/overnight block (~18:00-00:00 UTC) net-maker-positive in recent + lockbox; razor-thin and maker-only (forward-test, not a validated edge).
seasonal_entry_hour_start.impact: shifts the seasonal entry window; 18 = validated start

seasonal_entry_window_hours.description: Length in hours of the session_seasonal entry window starting at seasonal_entry_hour_start (7 = hours 18,19,20,21,22,23,0 UTC).
seasonal_entry_window_hours.impact: wider = more seasonal entries (dilutes toward the always-on baseline); narrower = only the strongest hours

macd_fast.description: Fast EMA period for the macd_cross pattern's MACD line (MACD = EMA(fast) - EMA(slow)).
macd_fast.impact: lower = more responsive MACD line, more/earlier crosses; higher = smoother, fewer signals

macd_slow.description: Slow EMA period for the macd_cross pattern's MACD line.
macd_slow.impact: higher = slower MACD line, fewer crosses; lower = more crosses

macd_signal.description: Signal-line EMA period (EMA of the MACD line) for the macd_cross pattern; a cross of MACD over its signal line is the trigger.
macd_signal.impact: lower = more responsive signal line, more crosses; higher = fewer, higher-conviction crosses

cci_period.description: Lookback for the Commodity Channel Index used by the cci_mom pattern; entry fires when CCI breaks out through its definitional +/-100 level.
cci_period.impact: lower = more responsive CCI, more breakouts; higher = smoother, fewer higher-conviction breakouts
